Class HttpStatus

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.api.io.net.http.HttpStatus
public final class HttpStatus extends Object
Named HTTP status codes for HttpServer.respond(int, String, String)'s status parameter, which stays a plain int — these are ordinary compile-time-constant int fields, not a new intrinsic or type, exactly like Gpio.OUTPUT.
